Produce v6-12 positive quotas mute only that broker across connection slots, retaining original delivery/close budgets and readable in-flight responses; v3-5 use server throttling. Zero/negative values do not cancel outstanding intervals. Fixed-size saturating metrics report requested time, not elapsed waiting. Deterministic peer tests and pinned Apache 4.3.1 scheduling reference qualify this scope; no live quota deployment or other API quotas claimed (KL05-08).

Fetch v8-17 response quotas mute only that broker from each individual response completion; v4-7 use server throttling. Eligible brokers and buffered records continue delivering. All-muted waits respect poll/request budgets, wakeup and caller cancellation without changing later one-shot settings; over-budget bodies still contribute quota headers. Fixed-size requested-time metrics and deterministic peer tests plus executed Apache 4.3.1 scheduling reference qualify this scope. Admin/heartbeat/group quotas and live quota deployments are excluded (KL05-09).
